name: A Putrid Task
summary: Deathguard Dillinger sends you west from Brill to hold the old bridge against the Scourge. Bring back proof that the dead are destroyed, and Tirisfal's defenders can keep the road clear.

sections.title: Holding the Bridge
sections.body: Brill guards a crossroads in eastern Tirisfal Glades, where an enemy approach threatens the Forsaken stronghold. Scourge wander west across the waterways and gather around the broken old stone bridge. Without patrols to drive them back, the shambling dead could block travel between Brill and the western farmsteads.

sections.title: A Grudge Against the Mindless
sections.body: For the Forsaken, Scourge on their borders are more than a threat to defend against. Each mindless ghoul and rotting corpse recalls the servitude and torment they escaped under Lady Sylvanas Windrunner. Deathguards like Dillinger take grim satisfaction in crushing their former captors. They demand severed claws as proof that the mindless dead have been put to rest for good.

faq.answer: Deathguard Dillinger, an officer of the Forsaken guard, gives the order from Brill's western exit in Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: Why does Deathguard Dillinger want putrid claws?
faq.answer: The claws prove the wandering Scourge have been destroyed, not merely driven away from the main road.

faq.q: Where are the rotting dead found?
faq.answer: The rotting dead wander the overgrown fields and riverbanks just west of Brill, gathering around the old stone bridge.

faq.q: Why are there Scourge in Tirisfal Glades?
faq.answer: The Forsaken took Lordaeron's capital and the surrounding glades from the Scourge, but Scourge have trickled into Tirisfal Glades and infested the land west of Brill near the old bridge.

faq.q: What happens after completing this task?
faq.answer: Once the bridge is clear, trouble on nearby farmsteads sends you farther west to inspect the overrun mills.

faq.q: Are the Forsaken and the Scourge not the same thing?
faq.answer: No. The Forsaken are free-willed undead who broke the Lich King's telepathic control and fight to protect their freedom. The Scourge remain mindless thralls bound to the Iron Will of the Frozen Throne.

angles.text: As Forsaken, destroying the Scourge is personal vengeance against the force that once held your mind captive.
As a member of the Horde, you help secure Brill and protect its foothold in the Eastern Kingdoms from the Scourge.
